claims.explanation: TW-37 is a BH3-mimetic pan-inhibitor of BCL2/BCL2L1/MCL1, so selectivity is best explained by which anti-apoptotic BCL2-family proteins the tumor depends on: lines with high MCL1 or BCL2L1 expression and intact apoptotic priming are sensitized, while lines with low dependence on these proteins or with alternative survival signaling are protected. The pattern of sensitizing mutations (PTEN, PIK3CA, KRAS, TP53, ARID1A, RB1) is consistent with PI3K/MAPK-driven tumors that upregulate MCL1/BCL2L1 and rely on them for survival, whereas BRAF-mutant lines (AM38, CAL12T, 8305C) are relatively protected, matching the known MAPK-driven, MCL1-dependent melanoma resistance described for TW-37.

features.basis: TW-37 binds MCL1 with high affinity (Ki 260 nM) and MCL1 dependence predicts BH3-mimetic killing
TW-37 binds BCL-xL (Ki 1110 nM) and BCL-xL dependence mediates sensitivity
TW-37 was designed to target the BCL2 BH3 groove and BCL2 overexpression predicts response
PTEN loss activates PI3K/AKT, which upregulates MCL1 and creates BH3-mimetic dependence; enriched in killed lines
PIK3CA activation drives AKT-dependent MCL1 expression and dependence; enriched in killed lines
KRAS/MAPK signaling upregulates MCL1 and BCL-xL, sensitizing to BH3 mimetics; enriched in killed lines
ARID1A loss is enriched in killed lines and may impair DNA-damage/apoptotic responses increasing BH3-mimetic sensitivity
RB1 loss is enriched in killed lines and may lower apoptotic threshold
TP53 mutation is common in killed lines and may reflect reliance on anti-apoptotic BCL2 proteins for survival
BRAF-mutant lines (AM38, CAL12T, 8305C) are among the least affected, consistent with MAPK-driven MCL1-independent survival
EGFR-mutant lines (HCC4006, RL952) show reduced sensitivity, suggesting EGFR-driven survival bypasses BCL2-family dependence
SMAD4 mutation is enriched in least-affected lines (TCCPAN2, ASPC1, HGC27), possibly reflecting alternative survival signaling
